notes.body:
Losartan body model
Whole-body model of losartan, its active metabolite E3174 and its other (inactive) metabolites with the blood circulation, the tissue distribution, the submodels of the intestine, the liver and the kidneys, and the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) on which E3174 acts.
The circulating species are whole blood concentrations: the blood flows transport the blood concentrations, the plasma concentration is the blood concentration over the blood to plasma ratio BP_<sid> (losartan 0.53, E3174 0.58 [Lo1995], the other metabolites 1). The tissues exchange with the blood by the flow ftissue_<sid> towards the tissue/blood partition coefficient Kp_<sid>.
Literature values of the model [Lo1995, FDA1995S60]: plasma clearance of losartan 610 ml/min (renal 70 ml/min, 12 %), Vss 34 l, terminal half-life 2.1 hr, bioavailability 33 % by hepatic first pass with nearly complete absorption, 14 % of a dose is converted to E3174; E3174 plasma clearance 47 ml/min (renal 26 ml/min, 55 %), Vss 10 l, half-life 6-9 hr. After 14C losartan 43 % (IV) and 35 % (PO) of the radioactivity is recovered in the urine (losartan 11.4 % and 4.5 %, E3174 6.4 %), 50 % and 58 % in the feces.
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

The E3174 of plasma at which half of the AT1 receptors are blocked. Fitted to the renin, angiotensin II and aldosterone of the PD data: a blockade of 0.83 at the peak and 0.09 at 24 hr after 100 mg losartan. The inhibition of the pressor response to angiotensin II is about 0.85 at the peak and 0.25-0.40 at 24 hr [FDA label]; the E3174 of the model falls faster than measured (terminal half-life 3.4 hr against 6.3 hr [Lo1995]).

parameter.name: feedback of the AT1 signal on the renin secretion

body.p: The renin secretion is the AT1 signal to the power -RENSEC_n (the short loop feedback of angiotensin II on the juxtaglomerular cells). In the steady state renin and angiotensin II rise by (1 - fe)^(-n/(1+n)) and the AT1 signal and aldosterone fall to (1 - fe)^(1/(1+n)): PRA x2-3 and aldosterone -20 to -40 % at the peak of 50-100 mg losartan.
The value of RENSEC_n is the result of the fit PD_20261019_134029__a3a50, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

Relative activity of CYP2C9: 1.0 normal activity (wildtype), <1.0 reduced activity (genotypes, inhibition), >1.0 increased activity (induction). Set by the experiments (genotype, interactions), not fitted.

parameter.name: fraction of the formation of the other metabolites by CYP2C9

body.p: The oxidative metabolites of losartan (L-158,795/796) are formed by CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, the glucuronides by UGTs. 0.5 gives together with the formation of E3174 a CYP2C9 share of about 0.55 of the hepatic clearance: losartan AUC x2.4 and E3174 AUC x0.12 in CYP2C9 *3/*3 [Bae2011], losartan AUC x1.67 and E3174 AUC x0.165 with bucolome [Kobayashi2008].

First order: the Km of CYP2C9 for losartan (about 1.1 µM unbound [Maekawa2009, Wang2014]) is far above the unbound concentrations (fu 1.3 %), the exposure is dose proportional from 25 to 200 mg [Ohtawa1993]. 14 % of a dose is converted [Lo1995].
The value of LI__LOS2E3174_k is the result of the fit PK_20261019_113633__d9465, its uncertainty is the profile likelihood of the fit.

body.p: Exchange of losartan between the blood and the hepatocytes, partly by OATP transporters (OATP2B1). Assumption: fast exchange, i.e., the concentration of the hepatocytes is the one of the blood and the hepatic clearance is limited by the metabolism and the blood flow (extraction 0.68 [Lo1995]).
Oxidation of losartan via the aldehyde E3179 to the carboxylic acid E3174, mainly by CYP2C9 (minor CYP3A4).
